Value.string:
This is the travelator “source code”. It is an Apple Shortcut. However, all remaining comments are directed towards the Shortcuts editing user.

if device is iPhone, look for a note called “1” containing “￼”. If it doesn’t exist, create home screen shortcut and note

stop, draw attention to home shortcut, assume user taps it

WFWorkflowActionParameters.WFCommentActionText:
0. update timestamp and paste it identically into version.txt, which is downloaded and saved to Shortcuts/travelator/version_yyyyMMdd_HHmmss.txt

1. share shortcut to icloud and save the URL to https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cubbage/modular/refs/heads/main/latest.txt

2. when the shortcut runs, it’s then matched against the timestamp below, and if the counted matches <1, the sharelink is retrieved, the shortcut is installed, and it should overwrite the value below, ending the update loop.

modifying the shortcut without updating the timestamp on the gh server is okay, any new dependencies/enhancements obviously won’t be pushed. 

be careful NOT TO OVERWRITE YOUR OWN LOCAL COPY with an “earlier root” and lose all shortcut enhancements, confusingly.
